name: CS Round
purpose: Resolve one authoritative defusal round from objective state, living teams, and the round clock. Send bomb, attackers, defenders or clock, separated by spaces; it answers continue, attack or defend, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: CR-01: the app always answers defend when bomb is defused. CR-02: the app always answers attack when bomb is exploded. CR-03: the app always answers continue when bomb is planted and attackers equals 0 and defenders is above 0.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  bomb is defused → defend
  bomb is exploded → attack
  defenders equals 0 → attack
  attackers equals 0 and bomb is absent → defend
  clock equals 0 and bomb is absent → defend
  otherwise → continue
proposition.plain: Resolve one authoritative defusal round from objective state, living teams, and the round clock.
